newsitem.title: USA: Niagara Mohawk nuke shut for planned outage.
newsitem.headline: Niagara Mohawk nuke shut for planned outage.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp's 1,137 megawatt Nine Mile Point nuclear power unit 2 was shut over the weekend for scheduled refueling and maintenance, a company spokesman said.
"We did shut that unit over the weekend as planned," spokesman Alberto Bianchetti said Monday.
The unit, located in Scriba, N.Y., was scheduled to be out of service for 35 days from September 28.
The 610 megawatt Nine Mile Point unit 1, also located in Scriba, was operating normally at 100 percent production, Bianchetti said.
